title: Baritone FEATURES.md — fall limits, dangerous block avoidance, segmented pathing
content_excerpt: Baritone falls up to 3 blocks onto solid ground (configurable) and farther with a water bucket. It knows not to walk through fire or on magma, not to corner over lava, not to break blocks touching a liquid, and it prices the break cost of blocks with falling blocks on top. Path calculation can end three ways: a full path, running out of time, or reaching render distance; when the best node sits at the loaded-chunk edge more than 50 times, calculation exits early.
evidence_notes: 证明“路径失败”常是分段规划的预期行为：渲染距离内找不到完整路径时应先靠近再重算，而不是判定目标不可达。危险方块规避条目支撑岩浆/火/液体相邻方块的禁止动作。
